description: Suno Studio effect. Cold tilt EQ, a bandpass voicing, a fixed-depth amplitude quantizer for glitch grit, and drive for icy, digital synth character. Apply to the rendered SYNTH stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Cold tilt EQ, a bandpass voicing, a fixed-depth amplitude quantizer for glitch grit, and drive for icy, digital synth character.

cold tilt.description: Cold tilt: cuts lows near 250Hz and lifts highs near 6kHz for an icy, thin voicing.
cold tilt.label: Cold

quantize.description: Amount of the fixed 8-level amplitude quantizer (copied from digital-degrade) blended in for glitch grit.
quantize.label: Quantize

filter.description: Band voicing corner: sets the highpass and lowpass pair for a cold bandpass feel.
filter.label: Filter

drive.description: Drive into the tanh stage after quantizing for extra edge.
drive.label: Drive

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
